title: Zadania komunikacyjne: w kawiarni
instruction: Odwróć kartę, przeczytaj sytuację i rozmawiaj.
instruction_uk: Flip the card, read the situation and talk. Use the menu on the lesson page.

items.back_scenario: You are in a café in Kraków. Your teacher is the waiter. Look at the menu. Order a drink and something to eat, ask the price and pay. Then do it again: different food, take away.
back_checklist: Poproszę … — Order a drink: with milk, with sugar or with lemon?
Na miejscu / na wynos — Eat in or take away?
Ile płacę? — Ask the price and repeat it.
Mogę zapłacić kartą? — Pay by card or in cash.
Dziękuję, do widzenia! — Say thank you and goodbye.

items.front_title: Ty jesteś kelnerem — you are the waiter
items.back_scenario: Now you work in the café. Your teacher is the customer and orders three things. Ask the questions, write the order, add the prices from the menu and say the total in Polish.
back_checklist: Dzień dobry! Co dla pana? — What can I get you?
Z mlekiem czy bez? — With milk or without?
Na miejscu czy na wynos? — Eat in or take away?
Kartą czy gotówką? — Card or cash?
